# Orthodontics in Fairfax Station, VA


Whole-mouth planning

Bite and jaw function

Doctor-led monitoring


## Orthodontics Done Right Makes the Difference


Straight teeth aren't just cosmetic. Proper alignment means you chew better, your jaw functions without strain, and teeth wear evenly. We focus on why teeth shifted, not just moving them.

We start with diagnosis, not brackets.

‍We evaluate bite, jaw function, and wear patterns first. Moving teeth without addressing the cause can make relapse more likely.

Orthodontics is part of a larger plan.

‍We consider bite stability, TMJ health, and future restorative needs. Goal is decades of stability.

Dr. Chris oversees every stage.

‍No handoffs. Same person evaluates, plans, monitors, and ensures stability.

Start With a Full Evaluation


## Orthodontics Is Part of the Plan, Not the Entire Plan


Watch Now

Most ortho practices move teeth and stop. We plan for what happens after. How does your bite function? Will teeth stay stable? What caused misalignment?

Orthodontics here integrates with whole-mouth health. We evaluate jaw joint, airway, bite forces, and restorative needs before moving anything.

Complete evaluation of bite, jaw, and airway We evaluate jaw closure, TMJ function, and airway alongside tooth position.

Treatment planning for long-term function Straight teeth that don't fit together create problems. We plan for stable function.

Coordinated with restorative work If you need veneers or crowns after, we plan both phases together.

One doctor, entire journey Dr. Chris evaluates, plans, and monitors personally. No handoffs.


## One Personalized Plan. A Naturally Beautiful Smile.


Veneers can feel completely natural when each one is designed around the whole smile.

## Your Orthodontic Options


Treatment choice depends on bite complexity, timeline, and goals.


### Clear Aligners


Removable plastic trays that shift teeth gradually using controlled pressure. Each set moves teeth slightly before switching to the next in the series. Treatment is planned digitally, so you see your projected result before starting. Trays are nearly invisible and come out for eating and cleaning.

Learn more


### Traditional Braces


Brackets bonded to teeth with wires that apply precise, controlled pressure. Adjusted every 4-6 weeks as teeth move into position. Offers the most control for complex movements and severe bite corrections. Works for cases where aligners can't achieve the necessary precision.


## One Doctor. Your Entire Journey.


Treatment starts with understanding goals and evaluating whether orthodontics alone achieves them.

Dr. Chris evaluates bite, jaw function, tooth wear, and airway. If grinding or TMJ contributed to misalignment, we address that. If restorative work follows alignment, we coordinate both.

No referrals out. Everything under one roof, one doctor.

Treatment planned digitally first. See your result before we start.

Progress monitored by Dr. Chris. Same doctor, start to finish.

Retention built into the plan. Keeping teeth straight matters as much as moving them.

## The Level Other Dentists Train Toward


Dr. Chris teaches advanced dental planning to other dentists. That same diagnostic discipline guides orthodontic care at Livewell. Tooth movement is planned around bite function, jaw stability, airway, and long-term health.


## The Technology Behind Your Treatment


Digital impressions create precise 3D models. No goop. Better accuracy.


### Intraoral Scanning


We capture digital impressions of your teeth to create precise 3D models. This eliminates uncomfortable goop trays and provides more accurate data for treatment planning and aligner fabrication.


### 3D Treatment Simulation


Before moving a single tooth, we simulate your entire treatment digitally. You see your final result, understand the timeline, and know exactly what movements are involved before committing.


### CBCT 3D Imaging


This technology evaluates your bone density, root positions, and jaw structure in three dimensions. Critical for complex cases where we need to see what's beneath the gum line to plan safe, effective tooth movement.


### Digital Progress Tracking


We monitor your tooth movement digitally throughout treatment. If something isn't tracking as planned, we catch it early and adjust rather than discovering issues months later.


### Custom Appliance Fabrication


Your aligners, retainers, and any functional appliances are designed digitally and fabricated through precision manufacturing. This ensures better fit, faster turnaround, and consistent quality.


### Bite Analysis


We don't just straighten teeth - we ensure they fit together properly when you bite down. Digital bite analysis confirms your final result is functional and stable, not just visually straight.

## Start With Clarity, Not Commitment


At Livewell, orthodontic treatment begins with a clear evaluation before any decision is made. You leave your visit understanding what is happening with your teeth, bite, and jaw function — and which options make sense for your goals.

Schedule Your Consultation

Call Us

How long does orthodontic treatment take?

Depends on case complexity. Clear aligners for mild crowding: 6-12 months. Comprehensive correction with braces: 18-24 months or longer. We give you a specific timeline during consultation.

Am I too old for orthodontics?

No. Adults make up a significant portion of ortho patients. As long as teeth and gums are healthy, treatment works at any age.

Do I need to wear a retainer after treatment?

Yes. Teeth naturally shift back toward original positions. Retainers hold teeth while bone and tissue stabilize. Most patients wear full-time for months, then nightly indefinitely.

Can orthodontics fix my bite, or just straighten my teeth?

Orthodontics corrects many bite issues: overbites, underbites, crossbites, open bites. Severe skeletal discrepancies may require orthodontics plus jaw surgery.

What's the difference between clear aligners and braces?

Clear aligners: removable, nearly invisible, work for mild to moderate cases. Braces: fixed, offer precise control, work for severe crowding or bite issues.

Can I eat normally during orthodontic treatment?

With clear aligners, yes. Remove them to eat. With braces, avoid hard, sticky, crunchy foods that damage brackets or wires.

mainEntity.name: How long does orthodontic treatment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment time depends on the complexity of your case, the type of orthodontic treatment, and how your teeth respond. Some mild cases may take several months, while more complex bite correction can take 18 to 24 months or longer. We give you a realistic timeline after your diagnostic records are reviewed.

mainEntity.name: Is Invisalign as effective as braces?

acceptedAnswer.text: For many mild to moderate alignment problems, Invisalign can be very effective. Braces may provide more predictable control for complex tooth movements, significant bite correction, or cases where removable aligners are not ideal. The right choice depends on your diagnosis, not just preference.

Yes. Teeth can move at any age as long as the teeth and gums are healthy enough for treatment. Many adults choose Invisalign or braces to improve alignment, bite function, or prepare for restorative and cosmetic dentistry.

mainEntity.name: Will orthodontic treatment change my face?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orthodontic treatment can influence how your smile sits within your face, especially when bite position, arch width, or tooth position changes. At Livewell Dental, we evaluate facial proportions, lip support, and smile display as part of planning so the result looks balanced and natural.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a retainer after orthodontic treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Retainers help hold the teeth in their new positions while the surrounding bone and tissues adapt. Teeth can shift over time without retention, so wearing your retainer as instructed is important for protecting your result.

mainEntity.name: Can orthodontics help TMJ or jaw pain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes orthodontic treatment can be part of a larger plan when bite problems contribute to jaw stress, but jaw pain can have several causes. A proper diagnosis is important before assuming tooth movement will solve the problem.

mainEntity.name: Can I eat normally during orthodontic treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: With clear aligners, yes. Remove them to eat. With braces, avoid hard, sticky, crunchy foods that damage brackets or wires.
